MORENEOW-NEOWS_REBIRTH.title: Neow's Rebirth
MORENEOW-NEOWS_REBIRTH.description:
At the end of combat, you may transform a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Removed from your [gold]Deck[/gold] after {Combats:diff()} combats.
MORENEOW-REGENT_ATTACK_SCRAPPED.title: Astral Flux
MORENEOW-REGENT_SKILL_SCRAPPED.title: Heaven's Gaze
MORENEOW-REGENT_SKILL_SCRAPPED.descripti:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] and {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to all enemies.
MORENEOW-REGENT_ATTACK.title: Lens Flare
MORENEOW-REGENT_SKILL.title: Reform
MORENEOW-REGENT_SKILL.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you create a card, reduce this card's cost to 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} this turn.
MORENEOW-SILENT_ATTACK.title: Blade Arc
MORENEOW-SILENT_ATTACK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Next turn, add {ShivNextTurnPower:diff()} [gold]Shiv[/gold] into your hand.
MORENEOW-SILENT_SKILL.title: Ready
MORENEOW-SILENT_SKILL.description:
Gain 1 [gold]Block[/gold] for each card in your hand.{InCombat:
(Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold])|}
MORENEOW-NECROBINDER_ATTACK_SCRAPPED.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Increase this card's damage by 1 this combat and give it [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
MORENEOW-NECROBINDER_SKILL_SCRAPPED.desc:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you have no [gold]Souls[/gold] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], add a [gold]Soul[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
MORENEOW-IRONCLAD_ATTACK_SCRAPPED.title: Puncture
MORENEOW-IRONCLAD_SKILL_SCRAPPED.title: Brace
MORENEOW-IRONCLAD_ATTACK.title: Combo Strike
MORENEOW-IRONCLAD_ATTACK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this is the third attack you played this turn, gain {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
MORENEOW-IRONCLAD_SKILL.title: Brawl
MORENEOW-IRONCLAD_SKILL.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
The next time you play an attack, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the damage it deals.
MORENEOW-DEFECT_ATTACK_SCRAPPED.title: Echo
MORENEOW-DEFECT_ATTACK_SCRAPPED.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you [gold]Evoked[/gold] an Orb this turn, hits twice.
Add a [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
MORENEOW-DEFECT_SKILL_SCRAPPED.title: Recursion
MORENEOW-DEFECT_SKILL_SCRAPPED.descripti:
[gold]Evoke[/gold] your rightmost Orb.
[gold]Channel[/gold] the Orb that was just [gold]Evoked[/gold].
MORENEOW-DEFECT_POWER_SCRAPPED.title: Iceberg
MORENEOW-DEFECT_POWER_SCRAPPED.descripti:
[gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Frost[/gold].
Whenever you [gold]Evoke Frost[/gold], gain {IcebergPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] next turn.
MORENEOW-DEFECT_ATTACK.title: Polish
MORENEOW-DEFECT_ATTACK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have a [gold]Status[/gold] card in your hand, trigger the passive effect of all Orbs.
MORENEOW-DEFECT_SKILL.title: Ooze
MORENEOW-DEFECT_SKILL.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Add a [gold]Slimed[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
MORENEOW-NECROBINDER_ATTACK.title: Nudge
MORENEOW-NECROBINDER_ATTACK.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
If [gold]Osty[/gold] has 10 or more HP, add a [gold]Soul[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
MORENEOW-NECROBINDER_SKILL.title: Reinforce
